newsitem.title: GERMANY: Police say Danish bike gang not welcome in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Police say Danish bike gang not welcome in Germany.

text.p: German police said on Monday that members of a violent Danish biker gang believed to be visiting the western city of Dortmund were not welcome in Germany.

A spokesman said police would make it clear to the gang, the Bandidos, that Germany was "not an appropriate place" for them. Police say the gang members have been in contact with a Dortmund-based rock music group called the Ghost Riders.
The Bandidos have been fighting a rival gang, the Hell's Angels, in Denmark, Finland, Norway and Sweden to carve out territory for criminal activities.
The four-year feud between the rival gangs -- both off-shoots of U.S. groups -- has been fought with anti-tank missiles, explosives and guns and claimed the lives of several members.
